name: Slow-Braised Carnitas Platter with Warm Corn Tortillas
whyItWorks: Slow-cooked pork shoulder shredded into tender, melt-in-your-mouth chunks is free of dairy and tough fiber. Rolled into soft warm corn tortillas with Mexican white rice, it provides balanced energy.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for lean carnitas portions and request refried beans without heavy melted cheese. Omit raw jalapeños, onions, and salsa.
